package: DIP-8 (2.54 mm pitch, 7.62 mm row spacing)

2.name: ANODE
2.hint: LED anode; average forward current 20 mA max, reverse voltage 5 V max (p. 5) – a reverse diode across the LED where the input can be reversed

6.name: VO
6.hint: open collector of the Darlington output: low while the LED conducts, released (high through the pull-up) while it is dark (truth table, p. 1); VO max 7 V for the 6N138 (p. 5); CTR ≥ 300 % at IF 1.6 mA, VO 0.4 V, VCC 4.5 V (p. 6)

7.name: VB
7.hint: base of the output stage; every datasheet figure has pin 7 open (note 4, p. 8) – a resistor from pin 7 to pin 5 trades gain for a shorter turn-off

8.name: VCC
8.hint: supply of the photodetector; characteristics specified for 4.5 V ≤ VCC ≤ 5.5 V (p. 6); 0.1 µF from pin 8 to pin 5 'must be connected' (p. 1)

*.source: Lite-On DS70-2009-0001 Rev A, 2.1 6N138-L package dimensions (p. 2): lead 0.5 ± 0.1 mm wide, 0.26 mm thick, 3.3 ± 0.5 mm below the seating plane; no recommended hole given

hints: 6N138 of the 6N138/6N139 pair: VCC and VO max 7 V (p. 5); the 6N139 takes 18 V
characteristics hold for VCC 4.5–5.5 V and −40 … +85 °C (p. 6) – on a 3.3 V board the detector still wants 5 V; VO can be pulled up to the 3.3 V logic supply (open collector)
speed: tPLH ≤ 35 µs, typ. 10 µs at IF 1.6 mA, RL 2.2 kΩ (p. 7) – longer than half a 31.25 kbit/s MIDI bit at the limit; more LED current and a smaller pull-up shorten it
the SMD version 6N138S-TA1-L (C22451885) is in the same datasheet; its EasyEDA symbol names pin 2 '2' and pin 3 'NC'
sources: Lite-On 6N138-L/6N139-L series photocoupler data sheet, Spec No. DS70-2009-0001, Revision A, effective 04/12/2016 (BNS-OD-FC002/A4), LCSC's copy for C571211 https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/64f78b458a97d177d4c717e6ac089ff5.pdf?productCode=C571211, read 2026-10-31
functional diagram and pinout, p. 1: 1 NC, 2 anode, 3 cathode, 4 NC, 5 GND, 6 VO, 7 VB, 8 VCC; '0.1 µF bypass capacitor must be connected between pin 8 and pin 5'
absolute maximum ratings, p. 5: IF 20 mA average, VR 5 V, PI 35 mW, IO 50 mA, VO 7 V (6N138), PO 100 mW, VCC 7 V (6N138), Topr −40 … +85 °C

electrical characteristics, p. 6: VF typ. 1.1 V, max. 1.7 V at IF 1.6 mA; CTR 300 % min (1600 typ.) at IF 1.6 mA, VO 0.4 V, VCC 4.5 V (ctr_min_ratio 3.0); VOL ≤ 0.4 V at IF 1.6 mA, IO 4.8 mA; IOH ≤ 250 µA at VO = VCC = 7 V; 'specified over recommended temperature (TA = −40 … +85 °C, 4.5 V ≤ VCC ≤ 5.5 V)' (v_op_min_v, v_op_max_v of pin 8)
switching, p. 7: 6N138 tPHL typ. 1.6 µs, max. 10 µs; tPLH typ. 10 µs, max. 35 µs at IF 1.6 mA, RL 2.2 kΩ; pin 7 open (note 4, p. 8)
the output transistor's VO maximum entered as vce_max_v (7 V) and its output collector current as ic_max_a (50 mA)

cross-check, not the part's own datasheet: Broadcom/Avago 6N138 AV02-1359EN (March 4, 2015), LCSC copy for C17508946 – recommended VCC 4.5–18 V for the family, VCC 7 V max for the 6N138, note 4 'a resistor between pin 5 and 7 will decrease gain and delay time; significant reduction in overall gain below 47 kΩ', note 6 'RCC = 220 Ω' in series with VCC where dV/dt may exceed 50 kV/µs

open: no recommended operating LED current range in the Lite-On sheet (Broadcom's 6N138: 0.5–12 mA); the CTR is guaranteed at 1.6 mA only
VO is open collector – the schema has drive open_drain for it; the photodiode/first-stage split (VCC, VB) has no model: the simulation passes ctr_min × IF from VO to GND and ignores VCC
propagation delays at the operating point of a MIDI input (IF about 5 mA, a 1 kΩ pull-up to 3.3 V) are not in the data sheet – measure the RX edge on the board
no thermal resistance in the data sheet: LIM.t has no item for it
